# Arthinez — Tolotra Anthony RANDRIAMBOLOLONA

> Portfolio of a full-stack developer based in Antananarivo, Madagascar. This file summarizes the site for AI agents and LLMs.
> Canonical source: https://arthinez.netlify.app/ (French) — English version: https://arthinez.netlify.app/en/

## Profile
- Name: Tolotra Anthony RANDRIAMBOLOLONA (alias Arthinez)
- Headline: Full-Stack Developer · Cloud & DevOps · 42 Antananarivo · Certified Trainer at Axian University
- Location: Antananarivo, Madagascar
- Languages: French, English, Malagasy

## Professional experience
- Junior Developer — Hango (May 2026 – present · 6 mos): Designing a scraping system that extracts event data and enriches it so it can be stored in and displayed from Hango's database.
- Front-End Developer — Hango (Jan 2026 – Mar 2026 · 3 mos): Built the web interface of a platform for discovering and promoting events in Switzerland, helping users easily find parties, outings and cultural events. Live: https://app.hango.ch
- Integration Intern — Yas Madagascar (Mar 2026 – Jul 2026 · 5 mos): Designed and deployed a centralized authentication system based on Keycloak, and secured an API running in a Kubernetes cluster.
- Transcender — 42 Antananarivo (Mar 2026 – present · 8 mos): 42 curriculum stage reached after completing the Common Core, concluded by the Transcendence project.
- Cadet — Common Core — 42 Antananarivo (Feb 2024 – Mar 2026 · 2 yrs 2 mos): Training at 42, a school known for its fully hands-on, peer-to-peer pedagogy: solving complex problems through projects, with solid foundations in C, Linux and algorithms.

## Involvement & responsibilities
- Treasurer — Student Council, 42 Antananarivo (Mar 2024 – Sep 2026 · 2 yrs 7 mos): Sound and transparent financial management so the Student Council could run its projects and offer students quality events and services (outings, workshops, talks).
- Communications Manager — Student Council, 42 Antananarivo (Mar 2025 – Sep 2026 · 1 yr 7 mos): Internal communication between the Student Council and students, and management of its social media.
- Trainer — Parklife (Nov 2024 – Dec 2024, May 2025 – Jul 2025): 130 employees trained. Introductory computer training for Parklife staff: the essential basics to use digital tools confidently every day. A second session deepening the first training's content to make participants more autonomous.
- Trainer — Grandir Dignement Madagascar (Dec 2025, Jan 2026): Around fifteen young people trained. Two training days introducing young people to computers and the Internet, as part of a social impact project. Second training: key AI concepts, prompting techniques and ethical practices, to build critical thinking and autonomy.
- Event — Beyond the Game (November 22, 2025, 42 Antananarivo, Galaxy Andraharo): Gaming day run by the Student Council: Tekken 8 and FC25 tournaments, showcase of games made by 42 students and free play. Partners: Mass'in, Malagasy Federation of Esports, Yas Madagascar, SOKA.
- Event — BCode Mada (June 20, 2026, 42 Antananarivo): Programming contest organized with AlgoMada, hosted by 42 Antananarivo with official support from Yas.
- Event — Trail KVAA 2025 (2025, Angavokely forest station): Took part in the trail with the 404.42 Student Council team and helped with the organization: a human experience full of encounters, smiles and friendliness.

## Projects
- Event scraping and enrichment — Hango, 2026 — in progress [Web scraping, Data enrichment, Database]: Scraping system that extracts event data, enriches it and loads it into Hango's database so the events can be shown on the platform.
- Centralized authentication with Keycloak — Internship — Yas Madagascar, 2026 [Keycloak, Kubernetes]: Design and deployment of a centralized authentication system, and securing an API in a Kubernetes cluster.
- Transcendence — Common Core final project — 42 [TypeScript, Fastify, Prisma, Docker]: Real estate web platform: secure REST APIs with authentication and access control, user management, reservations and a credit system. Challenges: data modeling with Prisma and full containerization with Docker.
- Webserv — 42 curriculum — networking [C++, HTTP/1.1, Sockets]: HTTP/1.1 server written in C++ from scratch with no external library: protocol parsing, GET, POST and DELETE methods, concurrent clients handled with non-blocking I/O.
- Inception — 42 curriculum — system administration [Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, NGINX]: Multi-container infrastructure orchestrated with Docker Compose: every service runs in a custom image written from scratch, without Docker Hub images. Challenges: inter-container networking, data persistence and configuration hardening.
- 42 internal hackathon — 4th place — Team competition — 42 Antananarivo: Rapid prototyping and teamwork under time pressure in a competitive setting.
- Homer Simpson Award — Stupid Hackathon — Award: Awarded for the best project pitch.

## Skills

- Cloud, DevOps & security: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (learning, beginner level), Keycloak, NGINX
- Systems programming: C, C++, Linux / Unix, Algorithms, HTTP / sockets
- Soft skills: Training design and delivery, Communication, Non-profit financial management, Event organization, Teamwork & peer learning
